name: Thiersee
kurzbeschreibung: A picturesque village with the crystal-clear Thiersee and charming villages – a paradise for hikers and sunbathers.
beschreibung:
Thiersee lies at 678 m above sea level in the district of Kufstein, nestled between the striking Pendling and the foothills of the Brandenberger Alpen. The municipality with around 3,200 inhabitants comprises several small villages such as Landl, Mitterland and Vorderthiersee, which are spread around the lake of the same name. The proximity to the town of Kufstein – only about 10 km away – makes the place a quiet retreat that is nevertheless well connected.

The heart of the municipality is the Thiersee, a clear swimming lake with drinking water quality that warms up to 24 degrees in summer. A family-friendly sunbathing lawn, a children's playground and the managed Thierseerhof make the lake a popular excursion destination. Hikers will find routes of varying difficulty directly from the village centre – for example up to the Pendling summit with panoramic views over the Inntal or through the forests of the Tiefen Klamm. Cyclists and climbers also get their money's worth in the surrounding area. In winter, the region turns into a quiet snow-hiking area, away from the hustle and bustle of the large ski resorts.

Culturally, Thiersee is closely connected with neighbouring Erl, which is known for its Tiroler Festspiele and the world-famous Passionsspiele. In the local inns, hosts serve regional delicacies such as Kasnocken, Zillertaler Krapfen or fresh trout from the lake. Anyone looking for genuine Tiroler hospitality beyond the tourist hotspots will find a piece of unspoilt country life here.
